# Workspace Instructions

- Project type: Visual Studio Code extension
- Language: TypeScript
- Bundling: esbuild
- Linting/formatting: ESLint + Prettier
- Tests: not included yet
- Starter: command extension
- Packaging/publishing: use VSCE scripts in package.json

## Validation checklist

- Ensure dependencies are installed.
- Ensure `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build` pass.
- Keep contributions and command IDs in sync between source and package.json.
- Update README.md when commands or scripts change.
